source_reference.paper_title: Low functional diversity promotes niche changes in natural island pollinator communities
source_reference.paper_measurement_protocol: At each site, five pollinator individuals per species, or all individuals when fewer than five were available, were measured with digital calipers; mean proboscis length was calculated per species x site.

admission_rules: Join historical source traits by exact taxon name plus site whenever site-specific Table S2 values are available.
A taxon-level average across sites is not substituted for a site-specific value unless a separate prespecified transfer rule is declared.
Functional-group bins (<4.5, 4.5-9, >9 mm) are descriptive classes and are not numeric substitutes for Rao-Q distances.
Do not impute proboscis length from taxonomic family, body size, guild label, or external allometry in the primary Izu-compatible FDQ analysis.
Future field visitors with no exact source trait remain trait_missing until measured directly or supported by a prospectively frozen source.
Trait values must be frozen independently of SVD, dependency, fruit, seed, or floral-response outcomes.
next_recovery_order: recover supplementary Table S2 source-native numeric values
audit taxon-name and site-name mapping against the 2024 209-taxon visitor table
resolve the 211-versus-209 species-count discrepancy without fuzzy matching
freeze exact source rows and checksums
calculate FDQ only for exposure units whose admitted visitor abundance has complete trait coverage or a prespecified missing-trait rule
claim_boundary: No numeric proboscis lengths are reconstructed from functional bins or taxonomic expectations while Table S2 remains unrecovered. The 209 current taxa and 211 paper-reported species are not assumed to be identical sets.
